summary: sunday reports serving 5,000+ restaurants with over $7 billion in annual transaction volume and $335 million in tips collected annually, operating in the United States, France, and the United Kingdom.
Named restaurant/hospitality group customers of sunday include Lettuce Entertain You, Four Corners, Parched Hospitality Group, Boka Restaurant Group, and BrewDog.

sunday claims its QR-code pay-at-table and AI-assisted ordering products (sunday Pay, sunday Ordering, plus a Smart Handheld card device) deliver a 10% increase in top-line revenue, 15% higher average check, 72 minutes of recovered floor time per server per shift, and 10% higher staff tips for operators. (Scope note: Vendor-reported performance claims aggregated across sunday's customer base, not a single audited case study.)
